cohort: Pregnant women at 24-28 weeks of gestation, with their fetuses ultrasonographically evaluated.
finding: Preterm fetuses exhibited significantly higher fetal adrenal gland volume (AGV), fetal zone volume (FZV), corrected AGV (cAGV), and corrected FZV (cFZV) compared to term fetuses, suggesting these measurements between 24-28 weeks of gestation may be beneficial for predicting premature birth.
gest_age: Fetuses measured between 24-28 weeks of gestation.
